name: Chromium / Chrome

1.notes: Targets the running instance of the same profile.

1.how: Chrome DevTools Protocol at --remote-debugging-port=<port> (ws endpoint from http://127.0.0.1:<port>/json)
1.notes: Everything: navigate, DOM, network, input, accessibility snapshot. OpenMausBot's embedded browser already drives CDP; Phase 1 wires it to system Chromium.

2.how: ~/.config/chromium-flags.conf (Arch reads it at launch); managed policies in /etc/chromium/policies/managed/*.json

3.how: Tree present only with --force-renderer-accessibility (set by MausOS) or when the a11y bus reports IsEnabled. Page content under 'document web'.
3.notes: Without the flag the tree is empty: check maus doctor.

quirks: Google OAuth blocks embedded/app-mode windows; use a normal window for sign-in.
The MausOS shell itself is a Chromium app window (class mausos-shell); exclude it when targeting 'chromium'.
